subject: Pilot wrap: short review & gift card logistics
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Katie Lin <katie.lin@tangenthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap: short review & gift card logistics

Hi Katie —

Hope you and the team are doing well. Tangent's pilot wrapped up last week and we really appreciate the collaboration — the metrics look strong and your feedback about cold-start behavior helped prioritize an optimizer.

Quick ask: would you be willing to share a short public review of Redwood Inference (1–3 paragraphs) on TrustRadius or Capterra? We’re collecting a couple of customer voice pieces and a short review from your team would really help other healthcare customers evaluate us.

We want to make this low-friction — two options:
- Quick TrustRadius link (one-page flow)
- Capterra short review (two-question flow)

We can send a $50 e-gift card to say thanks (Amazon or Visa e-card). If you’re open, can you: 
1) Confirm which site you prefer (TrustRadius or Capterra)
2) Tell us the best email to send the gift card to (personal or procurement)

If it helps I can also share a one-page prompt and example paragraphs to speed writing. Attaching a short "how this helps" doc.

Appreciate it — and happy to join a 10-minute call if your team prefers to record a few lines instead of writing.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com]

[Attachment: review-instructions.pdf (PDF, 72KB)]

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the note and congrats on shipping the optimizer update — it made a noticeable difference for our throughput. Happy to help with a short review. TrustRadius would be my preference (our procurement folks read those).

Please send the TrustRadius link and the sample paragraph — I can get this done this week. For the gift card, please send it to my work email (katie.lin@tangenthealth.com).

—Katie
